# Rebecca 1.0.0

Rebecca 1.0.0 is the first stable release of the new panel generation. It replaces the legacy backend with a Go-native control plane, introduces a redesigned responsive interface, and expands Rebecca from an Xray panel into a broader multi-node traffic and application platform.

## Highlights

- 🐹 **Go-native rewrite** — the master backend, API, authentication, subscriptions, user management, service handling, runtime orchestration, maintenance jobs, and node control paths now run in Go. Legacy Python runtime paths have been removed, while the master-to-node control plane now uses a hardened gRPC channel.
- 🎨 **Redesigned panel UI** — a faster, responsive interface with consistent dialogs, streamlined settings, improved navigation, compact data tables, live refresh controls, richer mobile layouts, localized copy, and lower rendering and bundle cost.
- ⚖️ **Automated HAProxy routing** — share one or more public ports between multiple Xray inbounds, non-Xray services, and websites. Rebecca detects eligible traffic by SNI, HTTP Host, or HTTP Path, generates per-node configurations, supports node-specific listeners and certificates, and can send unmatched traffic to a default website or service.
- 🧩 **External Apps hosting** — deploy isolated Node.js and PHP applications, manage files from the panel, attach domains and TLS certificates, host multiple MirzaBot instances, and apply safe application updates.
- 🧠 **Per-node core management** — manage runtime configuration, Xray core behavior, Geo files, health, metrics, logs, restarts, updates, and service operations independently for each node.
- 📦 **Bulk Actions** — perform large user and node operations from dedicated workflows, with conditional actions, active selection, grouped history, and batch service or restart operations.

## Security and administration

- Admin sessions with device visibility and revocation controls
- Two-factor authentication for administrators
- Shared IP and concurrent-session limits across nodes
- Live client IP and location insights
- Delegated admin API keys and bearer-token access
- Per-service admin traffic limits, permissions, roles, and usage-reset controls
- Creator attribution for delegated administrators
- Safer login throttling, node identity handling, and certificate verification

## Users, traffic, and observability

- Live online status, last-connection details, upload/download speed, and configurable auto-refresh
- Responsive user and administrator tables with traffic progress, remaining quota, lifetime usage, and expiry countdowns
- Aggregated inbound and outbound traffic accounting across nodes
- Per-inbound usage coefficients and direct inbound usage resets
- Advanced search with case-sensitive and whole-word matching
- Live Connections with immediate filtering and detailed session inspection
- Recent Actions with grouped activity, configuration diffs, filters, pagination, and scoped Xray rollback history
- Live node metrics, uptime, health checks, and operational status
- Dashboard throughput insights and combined live-user traffic speed

## Protocols, routing, and subscriptions

- Managed OpenVPN, WireGuard, L2TP, PPTP, IKEv2, and AnyConnect runtimes
- Hysteria, VLESS encryption, XHTTP appearance and obfuscation, FinalMask, and extended transport controls
- Tor, Psiphon, Windscribe, NordVPN, and subscription-managed outbound helpers
- Concurrent latency checks plus practical TCP, ICMP, and routing tests
- Client-specific subscription templates and outputs, WireGuard profiles, key-username links, and improved Android, sing-box, Shadowsocks, and VLESS compatibility
- Safer multi-node user reconciliation and runtime hot updates

## Certificates, hosts, backup, and maintenance

- Multiple managed certificates with SNI-based serving, filtering, renewal, revocation, and SHA-256 fingerprint generation
- Guided host configuration with context-aware TLS, transport, and FinalMask options
- Unified Settings save flow and refreshed Subscription and Telegram settings
- Dashboard backup import/export with automatic backup-type detection and upload progress
- In-panel update confirmation, streamed update logs, blocking progress state, and automatic recovery after restart
- Embedded tutorials and offline API documentation

## Upgrade notes

> Back up the database before upgrading. Rebecca 1.0.0 includes automatic schema migrations and a major runtime transition. Update the panel and Rebecca Node deployments together so all new control-plane and runtime capabilities are available.
